name: prompt-tweaks
description: Adds a session note to the system prompt and expands trailing :short, :why and :opts shorthands in typed prompts.

note.title: System prompt note
note.description: Text appended to the system prompt as a session section. Leave empty to append nothing.
note.default: The prompt-tweaks mod is active in this session. If the user asks which mods are active, say that prompt-tweaks is.
